#https://github.com/Cristian-Blanco/AudioTimeStamp-Detective/tree/main
#https://ubuntushell.com/setup-apache-with-python-wsgi-on-ubuntu/
#https://itsfoss.gitlab.io/post/how-to-setup-apache-with-python-wsgi-on-ubuntu/

Key files/locations on server:
/mnt/ubuntu01/AudioTimeStamp-Detective
	* user&group www-data needs to be granted access:
		+ from /mnt/ubuntu01, call "sudo chown -R www-data:www-data /AudioTimeStamp-Detective"
	* /logs - python logs generated by /app/Utils/AudioFileManager.py
	* /storage - holds NumPy matrices (.npz archives) for later analysis
	* .env - static file paths/settings.  Loaded into virtual environment by app.wsgi 
	* /app - contains application files from github.  Unchanged except for some fixes to /app/Utils/AudioFileManager.py
	* requirements.txt - unchanged from github, except fixed misspelled name
	* /venv
		+ created by calling "python3 -m venv venv"
		+ activated by calling "source venv/bin/activate"
		+ install dependencies by calling "pip install -r requirements.txt"
/var/www/AudioTimeStamp-Detective
	* app.wsgi
		+ only file in here, sets up the python environment for Apache
		+ need to load .env file here, as this can't be accessed within a WSGI/virtual environment
/var/log/apache2
	* tail -f AudioTimeStamp-Detective.log
	* tail -f AudioTimeStamp-Detective_access.log
/etc/apache2/sites-available
	* AudioTimeStamp-Detective.conf
		+ sets up the "site", but can't actually browse to it.  Need to use HTTP POST requests (see below)
		+ sudo a2ensite AudioTimeStamp-Detective.conf to enable site
		+ sudo a2dissite AudioTimeStamp-Detective.conf to enable site
		+ sudo systemctl reload apache2.service
		+ sudo systemctl status apache2.service
/etc/hosts (on laptop!)
	* map "AudioTimeStamp-Detective.jserver.lan" to server IP (192.168.69.10)


COMMANDS RUN FROM CLIENT (LAPTOP)
#https://linuxvox.com/blog/how-to-make-a-post-request-with-curl/
##https://linuxize.com/post/curl-post-request/
To load in a sample clip to the storage directory:
curl -F 'name_full_audio=test' -F 'full_audio=@./sample-6s.mp3' AudioTimeStamp-Detective.jserver.lan/audio-storage
Response:
{"error":false,"message":["Audio matrix saved successfully"]}


To load a full Podcast One show to the server:
curl -F "name_full_audio=\"1997-04-02 (Guest - no guest)\"" -F "full_audio=@\"/media/movies02/Loveline/1997/Loveline - 1997-04-02 (Guest - no guest).mp3\"" AudioTimeStamp-Detective.jserver.lan/audio-storage
Response:
{"error":false,"message":["Audio matrix saved successfully"]}


To locate the Podcast_One_Intro.mp3 snippet in the previous clip (should begin around 1:24):
curl -F "name_full_audio=\"1997-04-02 (Guest - no guest)\"" -F "audio_fragment=@/home/jeremy/Documents/Podcast_One_Intro.mp3" AudioTimeStamp-Detective.jserver.lan/stored-audio-detection
Response:
{"error":false,"message":{"location_in_seconds":84.3304081632653}}


To locate the "Untuck It" Ad Read in the previous clip (should begin around 24:02):
curl -F "show=[\"location_in_seconds\",\"location_in_minutes\"]" -F "name_full_audio=\"1997-04-02 (Guest - no guest)\"" -F "audio_fragment=@/home/jeremy/Documents/Untuck_It_AdRead.mp3" AudioTimeStamp-Detective.jserver.lan/stored-audio-detection
Response:
{"error":false,"message":{"location_in_minutes":"24:2.5","location_in_seconds":1442.5004081632653}}


To locate the AP News Update in the previous clip (should begin around 1:45:23):
curl -F "show=[\"location_in_seconds\",\"location_in_minutes\"]" -F "name_full_audio=\"1997-04-02 (Guest - no guest)\"" -F "audio_fragment=@/home/jeremy/Documents/AP_News_Colorado_Shooting.mp3" AudioTimeStamp-Detective.jserver.lan/stored-audio-detection
Response:
{"error":false,"message":{"location_in_minutes":"105:45.95","location_in_seconds":6345.954314058957}}


Results when searching for a snippet that isn't in the full clip (total length just under 1:46:30 or 106:30) :
curl -F "show=[\"location_in_seconds\",\"location_in_minutes\"]" -F "name_full_audio=\"1997-04-02 (Guest - no guest)\"" -F "audio_fragment=@/home/jeremy/Downloads/sample-15s.mp3" AudioTimeStamp-Detective.jserver.lan/stored-audio-detection
{"error":false,"message":{"location_in_minutes":"105:54.01","location_in_seconds":6354.013452380952}}
